company.name: BBy
company.shortDescription: BBy is a medical device company that condenses breast milk and turns it into powder.
company.description:
BBy is a medical device company that condenses breast milk and turns it into powder. The procedure of storing and administering donor breast milk in freezers, which wastes hours of professional nursing time defrosting and preparing the milk for feeding in the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU), has been disrupted by this innovation. 

Hospitals can repurpose current resources and expedite operations for more urgent requirements by removing the need for considerable manual handling and specialized storage facilities.

productsAndServices.description: A technology that removes unbound water from breast milk to create a condensed, shelf-stable powder that retains nutritional and immunological properties.
productsAndServices.name: Breast Milk Condensing Technology

aiResearchSummary.text: BBy is engaged in research and development of a human milk powderization system, as described in 'Powderization of human milk.' This work details a spray drying machine designed to receive liquid human milk and convert it into powder, involving a receptacle and a container to facilitate the process. The focus is on methods and apparatus for efficiently transforming breast milk into a powdered form, highlighting BBy’s efforts in milk powderization technology.
